caption: The drawing depicts a single human figure standing on a rectangular brown platform. The figure has light skin, long brown hair, and is wearing a floor-length dress that features a yellow base with a geometric, multicolored pattern composed of red, black, and cream shapes. Over the dress, the figure wears a red cape draped over the shoulders and a greenish-blue sash with red diamond-shaped patterns that wraps around the waist and hangs down the front. The right arm is bent at the elbow with the hand pointing outward, while the left arm rests along the figure’s side. The figure has a necklace and is depicted with bold outlines and defined facial features, including red lips and large eyes. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Bulto (Wooden Figure of Saint)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
